parts.name: Leg (Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the legs (temple arms) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ears and helps maintain stability and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the other leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, also made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides symmetrical support on the opposite side, ensuring balance and comfort when worn.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame and lenses, made primarily of glass and metal.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the optical correction or protection function of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and rigid, serving as the central structure to which the legs are attached.
